tasks.analysis: The sea lion population is booming on the Southern California coast, particularly around the San Diego area, where their thriving numbers are giving environmental scientists a reason to celebrate. This year, the number of baby sea lions researchers have counted on the California coastline is nearly double the amount counted just five years ago.
